[EN] Varmint Hunting
[ES] Caza de alimañas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill all you want. They breed like mad!
[ES] Mata a todos los que quieras. ¡Se reproducen como locos!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Good hunting!
[ES] ¡Buena caza!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find {@LinkCreature:76#3010#Beiran} at {@Rgn:76001$$Kanstria}'s gate.
[ES] Busca a {@LinkCreature:76#3010#Beiran} en la puerta de {@Rgn:76001$$Kanstria}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Wish me luck!"
[ES] «¡Deséame suerte!».
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate {@LinkCreature:49#20#zariik workers} east of the {@Rgn:49004$$Melgatol Portal}.
[ES] Elimina a los {@LinkCreature:49#20#trabajadores zariik} al este del {@Rgn:49004$$Melgatol Portal}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate {@LinkCreature:49#19#zariik spodas} near the {@Rgn:49005$$Kassian Tree}.
[ES] Elimina a los {@LinkCreature:49#19#spodas zariik} cerca del {@Rgn:49005$$Kassian Tree}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate {@LinkCreature:49#15#yusul slashers} southeast of the {@Rgn:49005$$Kassian Tree}.
[ES] Elimina a los {@LinkCreature:49#15#cortadores yusul} al sureste del {@Rgn:49005$$Kassian Tree}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Very strange."
[ES] «Muy extraño».
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to {@LinkCreature:76#3010#Beiran} at the gate to {@Rgn:76001$$Kanstria}.
[ES] Repórtate con {@LinkCreature:76#3010#Beiran} en la puerta de {@Rgn:76001$$Kanstria}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
